text.description_html:
Rixson ML19 Extra Heavy Door Intermediate Door Pivot Set

These 3/4" offset intermediate pivots are engineered for durability on extra heavy doors or lead lined doors. Set includes intermediate pivot with installation hardware.

Specifications: for Rixson ML19 Intermediate Door Pivot

  • Offset: 3/4"
  • Door Weight: Up to 1000 lbs
  • Hinge Leaf Height: 5"
  • Hinge Leaf Width: 1-1/8"
  • Total Hinge Width: 4-1/4"
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Supplied with needle bearings
  • US32D model UL listed for use on 3 hour fire doors
  • BHMA/ANSI C07321/3525
  • Handed - Must specify left hand door or right hand door when ordering

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
